prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ Crate, EqualCrate }`. `new Crate(length, width, height)` requires three finite positive numbers or throws `TypeError`. It exposes those dimensions as own properties. `volume()` returns their product, and `surfaceArea()` returns twice the sum of their pairwise products. `new EqualCrate(side)` must call the parent constructor with the same side for all dimensions and inherit both methods without overriding them. Inputs are not rounded or coerced.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
